part.text:
Done. The fix is in `crates/nu-command/src/filters/find.rs` (ByteStream branch of `find_with_rest_and_highlight`, find.rs:6046):

- Before: `let line = line?.to_lowercase();` — the whole line was lowercased before highlighting, so `open foo.txt | find abc` returned `abc`.
- After: keep the original line and only fold case for the match check (`line.to_lowercase().contains(term)`), letting the case-insensitive `(?i)` highlight regex paint the original text.

Validation:
- `cargo test -p nu-command --test main commands::find::` — all 15 pass, including the previously failing `find_with_bytestream_search_with_char`.
- Full `cargo test -p nu-command`: 1520 passed; the 3 remaining failures (`cd_permission_denied_folder`, `rm_prints_filenames_on_error`, `external_arg_expand_tilde`) also fail on the pristine baseline (environment-related, e.g. running as root) and are unrelated to this change.
